user.title: HA Monitoring
user.description: Configure intervals, tresholds, and exclusion lists by monitoring type.

section_timings.name: ⏱️ Timings & Delays
section_timings.description: Adjust refresh intervals, tresholds, and startup delay.

data_description.startup_delay: Duration during which scanning is bypassed after startup (default: 2 minutes).
data_description.scan_interval: Frequency at which the system checks for errors in entities, devices, integrations, applications, and checks for pending updates or repairs (default: 3 min).
data_description.system_info_scan_interval: Frequency at which the system checks for system information (default: 24 hours).
data_description.traces_scan_interval: Frequency at which the system checks for errors in automation and script traces (default: 30 min).
data_description.offline_timeout: Duration after which a device is considered offline (default: 24 hours).

section_exclusions_system.name: ⚙️ System Component Exclusions
section_exclusions_system.description: Ignore from scans specific Applications, Integrations, or Repairs.

data.excluded_repairs: Repairs to exclude (platform or name or keyword)

section_exclusions_unavailable.name: 🏷️ Unavailable Entity Exclusions
section_exclusions_unavailable.description: Ignore specific entities or with wildcards, or entire domains.

data.excluded_unavailable_globs: Keyword of names or IDs to exclude

error.invalid_interval: Interval must be at least 5 seconds.
error.invalid_timeout: Inactivity threshold must be at least 1 hour.
